estimators.ratio: N/S, Nf/Sf, N/Nf and S/Sf, and the leak factor (N/S)/(Nf/Sf): the ratio of two arms' means of stress-ng's own per-phase rate (or wall clock, or max-rss), with a BCa 95% interval over the run's rounds
estimators.columns: per-arm columns are medians of the same rounds; the ratio column is not the quotient of the two median columns beside it
estimators.raw: every cell carries rounds_raw, the per-round samples verbatim

provenance.diagnostic: the hashjudy cells with and without stress-ng's leak, outside METHODOLOGY.md's pre-registration
